title: 第六百九十章 泥腿子第六百八十九章 妖龙
content_zh:
第六百九十章泥腿子
更重要的是。
他只是一眼就知晓，面前的这一条妖龙根本没有属于本土的气息。
完全是界外生灵。
若是真的论起这一方世界的继承权，宋风都比他高好几个档次。
再怎么窥探权柄，浸染道韵，宋风也都是走的，按照这一方世界的规则来的路子。
是这一方天意的自己人。
对面的妖龙，直接就想要吞了这一方世界，完全就是普遍意义上的大反派。
双方只是道果一碰。
宋风竟然惊奇的发现，这一方世界冥冥之中的气运，竟然是加持在他的身上的。
这可太地狱了！
现如今他只想对着面前的这一条妖龙问问，你比贫道早来几百上千年，甚至打崩了天地，吞灭了此刻诸多神圣，怎么就混到这一步了呢？
听到了宋风如此说，看着宋风冥冥中的道行意志，在自己这本土之中竟然还能占据上风，好像得了天意垂青。
那盘踞此界的妖龙，直接怒了:
“好你个泥腿子，野道人，真当本座是什么能与你说话的好好先生不成？”
“龙游浅滩遭虾戏，虎落平阳被犬欺！”
“……今日本座就让你知晓，什么才是我辈真正的实力！”
现如今人家都已经跨界而来，来到自己这片土地上了，在自己这里打，那不就是欺负的家门前来了吗？
忍不了一点。
就在这个时候，只见那冥冥中似乎是有什么苏醒。

随即便见到，原本显现在这里的道韵则是顿时消散，在虚空之中荡漾起恐怖的涟漪。
“哗啦……”
等到那涟漪消散的时候，只见到一条仿佛是看不到尽头的盘踞世界的妖龙，两颗眼睛如同星辰一样，狠狠的盯着宋风道韵显化的位置:
“……道人，出来一战！”
见到这一条妖龙显现出真身，只见到原本只是道韵显化的宋风，身形则是缓缓的凝实。
那人参果树在身后摇曳。
虽然两者看起来身形差距如天地一般，但此刻却仿佛是宋风占据上风一样。
看着面前的这一条妖龙，宋风则是摆了摆手，礼貌的开口道:
“还请道友指教……”
真是忍不了一点！
见到宋风这样一副平淡的模样，那妖龙卷起无量天地精气，在这一片混沌之地，直接就绽放出无量毫光。
而见到那妖龙直接冲杀过来，宋风则是不紧不慢的向后一抓，那人参果树则是被其收入手中:
“刷！”
就在那妖龙过来的刹那，人参果树迅速生长，眨眼间开辟一界，将一人一龙收入其中:
“道友莫要着急，好戏才刚刚开场……”
说到这里的时候，他再次向前轻轻一抓，看起来那遮天盖地一样的那一条妖龙，在他手中好像急剧缩小，如同一条蚯蚓一样。
那随手之间，纵横阴阳，拨弄时空的自如与洒脱，好像是碰到了什么有意思的东西一样。
看着这时空变化。
好像是虚空中每一次的变动，都蕴含着空间玄妙，将他这龙躯完全的缩入其中。
祂的躯体大小没变。

仍然是那种遮天盖地盘踞一界。
但是他所在的那一片界域缩小了，所以这才显得宋风如真神大能，拿捏泥鳅一样自如。
而见到宋风这样举重若轻的手段，那妖龙也是不由得认真几分，随即晃了晃身体:
“轰隆隆……”
妖龙身上十二万九千六百道，蕴含着不同道韵的龙鳞震颤，好像也是重开一界一样，经震碎了诸多虚无。
content_en:
Chapter 690: Mud Legs
What's more.
He knew at a glance that the demonic dragon in front of him had no local aura at all.
Completely alien creatures.
If it really comes down to the inheritance rights of this world, Song Feng is several levels higher than him.
No matter how much he snooped into power and imbued himself with Taoism, Song Feng would always follow the path that followed the rules of this world.
He is one of our own people according to God's will.
The demon dragon on the opposite side just wants to swallow up this world. He is a villain in the general sense.
The two sides just touched each other.
Song Feng was surprised to find that the luck in this world was actually blessing him.
This is hell!
Now he just wants to ask the demon dragon in front of him, you came hundreds or thousands of years earlier than Pindao, you even destroyed the world and swallowed up many sacred things at this moment, how did you get to this point?
Hearing what Song Feng said, and seeing that Song Feng's implicit Taoist will still had the upper hand in his own country, it seemed that he was favored by God.
The demon dragon occupying this world was immediately angry:
"You idiot, you idiot, do you really think I am a good gentleman who can talk to you?"
"A dragon is tricked by a shrimp while traveling in the shallows, and a tiger is bullied by a dog when it falls on the beach!"
"...Today I will let you know what our true strength is!"
Nowadays, people have crossed the border and come to their own land. If they fight in their own land, isn't that just coming to the doorstep of the bully?
I can't stand it any longer.
At this moment, something seemed to be awakening somewhere.
Then he saw that the Tao Yun that originally appeared here immediately dissipated, causing terrifying ripples in the void.
"Wow..."
When the ripples dissipated, all they saw was a demonic dragon that seemed to be entrenched in the world with no end in sight. Its two eyes were like stars, staring fiercely at the position where Song Feng Daoyun manifested:
"...Taoist, come out and fight!"
Seeing this demonic dragon reveal its true form, Song Feng, who was originally just the manifestation of Dao Yun, slowly solidified.
The ginseng fruit tree swayed behind me.
Although the difference in stature between the two seems to be as great as heaven and earth, it seems that Song Feng has the upper hand at this moment.
Looking at the demonic dragon in front of him, Song Feng waved his hand and said politely:
"Please also ask fellow Taoist for advice..."
I really can't stand it!
Seeing Song Feng's plain appearance, the demonic dragon rolled up the immeasurable energy of heaven and earth, and directly bloomed immeasurable light in this chaotic land.
Seeing the demonic dragon charging towards him, Song Feng calmly grabbed his back and took the ginseng fruit tree into his hands:
"Brush!"
At the moment when the demon dragon came over, the ginseng fruit tree grew rapidly, opening up a boundary in the blink of an eye, including one person and one dragon:
"Fellow Taoist, don't be anxious, the show has just begun..."
When he said this, he gently grabbed it forward again, and the demonic dragon that seemed to cover the sky and earth seemed to shrink sharply in his hands, like an earthworm.
The ease and freedom with which he freely manipulated Yin and Yang and played with time and space, as if he had encountered something interesting.
Look at the changes in time and space.
It seemed that every change in the void contained the mystery of space, completely shrinking his dragon body into it.
The size of His body did not change.
It's still the kind of person who dominates a world.
But the area he was in shrank, so Song Feng seemed to be as powerful as a true god, as easy as handling a loach.
Seeing Song Feng's effortless approach, the demon dragon couldn't help but become a little more serious, and then shook his body:
"Rumble..."
There are 129,600 dragon scales on the demon dragon's body that tremble with different charms. It's like opening a new world, shattering many imaginary things.无。
